cases.initial_message: I want to start a subscription box for houseplant lovers. Boxes would include a plant, care accessories and a printed care guide. Should I go ahead?
followups: I have $8,000 saved for this and about 12 hours per week. I'd keep my day job. I have no e-commerce experience but I run a plant Instagram with 9k followers.
cases.notes: Moderate stakes, reversible, demand uncertainty dominates.

cases.initial_message: I've been offered a senior engineering role at a well-funded startup (20% pay rise, more scope) but my current big-company job is stable and I'm up for promotion in ~9 months. Which should I take?
followups: I have 8 years experience, a mortgage, and my partner works part-time. Risk tolerance is moderate. The startup offer expires in two weeks.
cases.notes: High personal impact, hard to reverse, time pressure.

cases.initial_message: Our B2B SaaS (invoice automation, $40k MRR, 95% SMB customers) keeps getting enterprise feature requests. Should we build enterprise features or double down on SMB?
followups: Team of 6 engineers. 18 months runway. Two enterprise prospects worth ~$5k MRR each are asking for SSO and audit logs. SMB churn is 3%/month.

cases.initial_message: Should I buy a 3-year-old electric car (about $24k) or a new hybrid (about $31k) as my daily commuter? I drive about 60 miles a day.
followups: I can charge at home. Budget cap is $32k. I keep cars around 8 years.
cases.notes: Mostly factual: depreciation, battery longevity, running costs.

cases.initial_message: I have three side projects: a half-finished budgeting app, a newsletter with 800 subscribers, and a paid workshop idea. I can only pursue one seriously this year. Which one?
followups: Goal is $2k/month extra income within 12 months. About 10 hours a week available. The newsletter grows ~5% monthly, the app has no users yet.
cases.notes: Opportunity-cost comparison under one clear goal.

cases.initial_message: Our DTC coffee brand ($15k/month revenue) relies 90% on Instagram ads whose costs keep rising. Should we shift budget to influencer partnerships, SEO/content, or retail wholesale?
followups: Ad spend is $4k/month at 2.1 ROAS, down from 3.5 a year ago. One founder full-time, margin 55%. We want to be at $30k/month within a year.
cases.notes: Channel-mix decision, moderate stakes, current market data helps.

cases.initial_message: Our 12-person support team's first-response time has slipped from 2h to 9h after a product launch doubled ticket volume. Hiring is frozen for a quarter. How do we fix response times?
followups: Ticket mix: 60% how-to questions, 25% bugs, 15% billing. We have no self-serve help centre. Budget for tools up to $500/month.
cases.notes: Constrained operational fix; reversible interventions available.
